decision: Establish a canonical 50-entry Imperial user-rank catalogue with 49 XP-earned progression ranks and a founder-only rank 50, without changing production data or the existing novel/author leaderboard.
invariants: The catalogue contains exactly 50 unique, sequential rank IDs.
Ranks 1-49 have strictly increasing non-negative XP thresholds.
Rank 50 is Imperial God Emperor, founderOnly=true, and minXp=null.
XP progression can return only ranks 1-49.
Imperial Rank never grants account roles, permissions, or administrative access.
Existing novel and author leaderboard behavior is preserved.
No D1 schema mutation, XP award, API exposure, founder assignment, or deployment occurs in this foundation change.
Only verified reader/author accounts earn XP for a first eligible rating; repeat rating edits do not award additional XP.
Authors do not earn XP for rating their own novel.
The public user leaderboard includes only verified, non-banned accounts that explicitly opt in.
Public leaderboard XP is period-specific while the displayed rank is derived from all-time XP.
Rank visibility changes are authenticated and scoped exclusively to the session user.
The founder-only rank 50 is not assigned by this integration.
Verified, active reader/author accounts may earn XP from first eligible ratings, first novel publication, and first chapter publication.
Novel and chapter publication awards are tied to first transition to published and use stable idempotency keys.
All positive XP awards are capped at 100 per user per rolling 24-hour period by the atomic ledger insert.
Unverified, banned, deleted, and admin accounts cannot earn public progression XP.
Founder rank 50 is resolved only when the authenticated account ID exactly matches the protected Worker variable IMPERIAL_FOUNDER_USER_ID.
Username, email, client flags, account role, XP, or public leaderboard position cannot assign founder rank.
The founder Worker variable remains unconfigured until the platform owner's actual Imperial Novel user ID is verified.
acceptance: The full repository build and governance checks pass.
API authorization registry includes authenticated POST /api/profile and validates its user-id scope.
Member leaderboard is a separate section from novel and author rankings.
First eligible novel/chapter publication awards are idempotent across author and admin publication paths.
The rolling 24-hour positive XP cap is enforced atomically by the database insert.
Founder identity resolver compares authenticated session user ID to protected server configuration only.
Unconfigured founder binding safely leaves all accounts on earned ranks 1-49.
releaseBoundary: Application integration depends on migration 0050 from PR #384. Do not merge/deploy this integration before that migration is merged and applied through the approved production release process.
